title: Write the solution
text: With $$K=25$$ and $$P_0=2$$, the solution can be written as $$P=\frac{25}{1+11.5e^{\left(-r t\right)}}$$.

title: Use the population at $$5$$ years
text: $$P(5)=8$$ means $$1+11.5e^{\left(-5r\right)}=\frac{25}{8}$$, so $$e^{\left(-5r\right)}=\frac{17}{92}$$ and $$r=\frac{\ln\left(\frac{92}{17}\right)}{5}$$, which is about $$0.3377$$.
